summary: Verified Optimization v1 (Premium Model Overuse Detector). Backend: 8/8 pytest tests pass covering endpoint shape, empty-state semantics, auth required, workspace isolation (403), and analytics/projects/reliability regressions. Frontend: Optimization page loads, three summary cards (opt-total-savings=$0.00, opt-finding-count=0, opt-detector='Premium Model Overuse v1 · Uses production pricing only · never demo') render, and optimization-empty card contains the exact required heading text + mentions 'production pricing (is_demo=false)'. All nav tabs (Dashboard/Projects/Usage/Costs/Reliability/Optimization/Settings) load without errors. ProjectDetail opens with Overview + API Keys tabs and no WS_HOLDER seen in console logs. The seeded workspace behavior of 0 findings is the expected PASS state (only demo pricing exists).
critical_code_review_comments: optimization.py is deterministic, pure detector + thin DB wrapper — clean separation; load_production_pricing correctly filters active=true AND is_demo=false.
GET /api/optimization/findings enforces membership via _resolve_project_ids → assert_workspace_member, which properly returns 403 for cross-workspace access (verified).
Response shape is stable: findings/finding_count/potential_savings/currency/has_production_pricing — matches spec.
Frontend Optimization.js correctly gates on count===0 and switches empty-state helper text based on data.has_production_pricing — good UX + honest messaging.
seed_data_creation: None. Did not insert production pricing (would require cleanup). Empty-state path verified as intended.
